_base_comp_note: BASE COMP = Churn Tier 3-3 for both port charts — the AUTOMATIC tier when the ICD has 19 or fewer port (resp. BYOD) activations in the month, which is where the crew's volume sits. When volume clears 19/month the real 0-30 x 90-day churn tier applies and these two numbers must move (full Chart 2/4 grids are in the PDF in output/fiber_metrics).
